title: Senior Housing Move-Out Inspection Form
subtitle: Operational move-out inspection intake, evidence, qualified review, exception routing, handoff, and accountable closeout.
description: An original fillable senior housing move-out inspection workflow that keeps identity, property-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exceptions, communication, and closeout in one traceable record.
use_case: Use when authorized property staff need to manage a senior housing move-out inspection from intake through verified handoff without using the record to make legal, accommodation, screening, compliance, or professional conclusions.

blocks.label: Move-Out Inspection reference
blocks.guidance: Use one identifier across messages, evidence, work orders, and handoffs.

blocks.label: Property and location
blocks.guidance: Confirm the exact property record before collecting workflow details.

blocks.label: Reporting and routing contact
blocks.guidance: Record only contact information needed to route and update this record.

blocks.label: Departure and agreement context
blocks.guidance: Record only context needed for inspection and turnover routing.

sections.title: Inspection basis, access, and evidence
sections.guidance: Define what can be compared and inspected.

blocks.label: Reference records available
blocks.guidance: Missing references must remain visible as an evidence limitation.
items: Move-in baseline or prior condition record linked
Approved alterations or improvement records linked
Relevant maintenance and repair references linked
Notice, scheduling, and authorized-entry status recorded
Photo or video series uses a stable timestamp and identifier
Participant comments and evidence can be preserved separately
Unavailable utilities or inaccessible areas are identified
Turnover, financial, and legal reviewers are distinct from inspector

blocks.label: Inspection event and access
blocks.guidance: Follow the applicable authorized-entry process.

blocks.label: Uninspected area, evidence gap, objection, or access exception
blocks.guidance: Do not treat lack of access or participation as agreement with an observation.

fields.label: Area, reason, stated objection, temporary control, owner, due point, and next step

blocks.label: Neutral inspection boundary
blocks.guidance: Describe observable condition, comparison source, and evidence. Do not assign fault, characterize wear, decide a charge, determine deposit treatment, authorize disposal, or make a legal conclusion in this inspection record.

blocks.label: Operational and qualified-review boundary
blocks.guidance: This move-out inspection record captures operational facts, routing, evidence, and authorized handoffs. It does not determine legal rights, tenancy, responsibility, habitability, code or accessibility compliance, accommodation eligibility, screening eligibility, or a professional opinion. Authorized property staff must review applicable policy, notice, privacy, retention, fair-housing, safety, insurance, and licensed-trade requirements.

blocks.label: Area-by-area condition comparison
blocks.guidance: Use exact locations and objective descriptions.

blocks.label: Equipment, utility, and final reading log
blocks.guidance: Basic status does not certify condition or compliance.

blocks.label: Returned keys, credentials, remotes, and supplied items
blocks.guidance: Do not record credential secrets. Route deactivation through the authorized system owner.

blocks.label: Remaining property, waste, surrendered items, or handling limitation
blocks.guidance: This record is not authorization to discard, transfer, sell, or retain property.

fields.label: Item, location, evidence, protective action, authorized route, owner, and due point

sections.title: Senior Housing context and responsibility
sections.guidance: Apply controls that are specific to this property type.

blocks.label: Senior Housing workflow controls
blocks.guidance: Check only controls actually reviewed; explain exceptions in the routing note.
items: Resident, authorized contact, unit, and departure event are identified
Communication and entry support are recorded without clinical information
Personal property and assistive items follow authorized handling routes
Keys, remotes, pendants, parking, and service equipment are reconciled
Housing, service, financial, and legal decisions remain separate
Accessibility or accommodation issues route to qualified review
Resident comments can be provided in the requested operational format
Unit turnover starts only after property and contact handoffs are verified

blocks.label: Responsibility and external handoff
blocks.guidance: A routing field records ownership; it does not decide disputed responsibility.

blocks.label: Senior Housing coordination facts and unresolved questions
blocks.guidance: Separate observed facts from assumptions and identify the next authorized reviewer.

fields.label: Property-specific facts, limitations, handoff details, and unresolved question

sections.title: Turnover scope, separate decisions, and authorization
sections.guidance: Route work without assigning legal responsibility.

blocks.label: Turnover work and separate-review register
blocks.guidance: Financial, responsibility, disposal, and legal decisions require their own authorized process.

blocks.label: Separate-review handoffs
blocks.guidance: Checking a handoff does not record the later decision.
items: Cleaning and repair scope routed for operational authorization
Potential regulated or specialist work routed to qualified staff
Responsibility or wear classification left to authorized review
Charge or deposit review uses approved evidence and process
Remaining property follows applicable notice and handling process
Disputed facts and resident evidence remain attached
Access and utility changes have authorized owners
Urgent safety condition has an immediate-control record

blocks.label: Turnover authorization
blocks.guidance: Authorization covers operational work only within the reviewer's authority.

blocks.label: Urgent condition, disputed fact, evidence gap, or escalation
blocks.guidance: Preserve the inspection record when later review reaches a different conclusion.

fields.label: Issue, immediate action, missing evidence, owner, due point, reviewer, and disposition route

sections.title: Comments, communication, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Close after every handoff has an owner.

blocks.label: Occupant comments, corrections, disagreement, or added evidence
blocks.guidance: Record the person's account without requiring agreement or waiver.

fields.label: Statement, evidence reference, requested correction, response owner, and status

blocks.label: Open action and communication register
blocks.guidance: Keep the record open while required actions lack a disposition.

blocks.label: Inspection closeout
blocks.guidance: Inspection completion does not mean financial or legal review is complete.

blocks.label: Inspection record preparation and acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Signatures confirm participation, preparation, or receipt only; a missing signature does not prove agreement.
